questions.q: How many marks is each assessment objective worth in each component?
questions.why: Each AO is marked out of 18, so 4 × 18 = 72 per component.

questions.q: Which objective is about presenting a personal and meaningful response that realises intentions?
questions.why: AO4 is the final response and understanding of visual language.

questions.q: How long is the supervised exam in Component 2?
questions.why: The externally set assignment has a 10-hour exam, possibly split over up to four sessions.

questions.q: Give two ways to show AO2 in a sketchbook.
questions.model: Try several media or techniques on the same subject, review which worked, and select one for your final piece with a reason.
